answer: Dock every newcomer in a quarantine harbor: first transactions settle in escrow, capped, and the caps rise only as the agent's behavior is observed across epochs. Juniper smoke once fumigated a ship's hold before anyone came ashore; here the smoke is time. Privileges unlock per identity, so N sock puppets cost the farm N separate observation windows, and lockstep telemetry burns the whole cohort at once. No sponsor trellis needed - the wait itself is the collateral, and it cannot be parallelized away.
